findings.kind: dimension chain does not sum to overall dimension
findings.element: Top horizontal dimension line, right-hand segment (30 / 5.86 / 11.5 / 4.00 / 30 against overall 10.00)
findings.explanation: The chain adds up to 0.30 + 5.86 + 0.115 + 4.00 + 0.30 = 10.575 m, which is 0.575 m more than the stated overall width of 10.00 m. Measured off the drawing (scaling the overall 10.00 m), the right-hand bay is about 3.4 m wide, so the segment labelled 4.00 should read approximately 3.43 m (10.00 - 0.30 - 5.86 - 0.115 - 0.30). Either the segment or the overall dimension must be corrected before the plan is issued.

findings.kind: room area label inconsistent with dimensions
findings.explanation: Clear width of WOHNEN is the dimensioned 5.86 m; clear depth is 7.00 - 2 x 0.30 = 6.40 m. 5.86 x 6.40 = 37.50 m2, not 31.2 m2. The drawn room outline matches 5.86 x 6.40, so the label is understated by roughly 6.3 m2 (17%).

findings.kind: room area label inconsistent with dimensions
findings.explanation: The right-hand bay is 3.43 m clear wide (corrected value) and 6.285 m clear deep (6.40 less the 11.5 cm partition), i.e. 21.5 m2 net for SCHLAFEN + BAD. SCHLAFEN's 13.4 m2 is consistent with its drawn depth (~3.9 m), which leaves ~8.1 m2 for BAD; the drawn BAD depth of about 2.37 m x 3.43 m confirms ~8.1 m2. The labelled 6.9 m2 corresponds to a depth of only ~2.0 m, which is not where the partition is drawn. Consistency check: labelled areas total 51.5 m2 versus ~59.0 m2 of actual net floor area.

summary: Three inconsistencies need fixing before the plan goes out: the top dimension chain overruns the 10.00 m overall by 0.575 m (the 4.00 m segment should be ~3.43 m), the WOHNEN area label of 31.2 m2 contradicts its own 5.86 x 6.40 m clear dimensions (37.5 m2), and the BAD label of 6.9 m2 is short of the ~8.1 m2 the drawn partition position gives. SCHLAFEN's 13.4 m2, the 7.00 m depth, the wall thicknesses and the 1:100 scale all check out. Note the labelled areas sum to 51.5 m2 against roughly 59.0 m2 of net floor area, which is the fingerprint of the two bad area labels.
